"Casino 7s" has 412,347 prizes of $5 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $1,000 prize, with 33 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

If you play "Casino 7s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2775.headline: What's actually left to win

2776.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Patriotic Payout", most are still unsold. The game is near the start of its run, with eight of eight top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Tomorrow's count on "Patriotic Payout" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2776.headline: Tickets sold so far

2779.body:
The most common win left on "Gnome for the Holidays" is $1. The second biggest prize left is $100, and 2,229 of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

Every line of Gnome for the Holidays's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2779.headline: What the prize table shows

2780.body:
"Holiday Countdown" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $5 game with five top prizes of $100,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

The numbers for "Holiday Countdown" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2780.headline: New in stores

2781.body:
"The Perfect Gift" just went on sale in Texas. The game has ten full prize levels with five top prizes of $250,000. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

Today's free summary of "The Perfect Gift" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
2781.headline: A new game is here

2782.body:
"$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" just reached Texas stores with four top prizes of $1 million. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the printed odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

For "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" or any game, being late in a run is not automatically good or bad. The same numbers mean different things near the end of a run.

If "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
